headline: Fresh Gaza strikes shadow fragile disarmament talks
summary: AP reports at least 17 people were killed as Israel raised security concerns about a proposed Hamas disarmament deal.
script: Gaza saw fresh Israeli strikes as negotiations over a Hamas disarmament plan remained unsettled. At least seventeen people were killed, while Israel said it had serious security concerns about the proposed deal.
imageAlt: Two men search through rubble after destruction in Gaza.
imageAltTwo: People gather around a destroyed car on a Gaza road.

sources.title: Israel faces serious concerns over Hamas disarmament plan as strikes continue
